data.name: One if by Land, Two if by Sea: Walking & Boat Revolutionary Small Group Tour
data.headline: Follow the steps and boat ride of Paul Revere leading up to the Revolution!
data.description:
Explore Boston’s Revolutionary sites on an epic land and sea tour! The tour starts with a walk along the Freedom Trail sites that tell the story of events leading up to the start of the American Revolution. Start at the Boston Massacre Site and proceed through historical Boston to Faneuil Hall, Quincy Market, Blackstone Block, Paul Revere House, and the North End. 

Halfway through the tour, take a short break at the Old North Church! Go inside the church (admission included in the price of the tour), browse for souvenirs, grab a snack.

The second half of the tour takes guests on a boat ride in the Boston Harbor to continue following the story of the American Revolution. Learn about the events of Bunker Hill from the spot where the British ships crossed the harbor to attack Charlestown. See the USS Constitution up close and personal from the water. Sail through the same route that Paul Revere took when he rowed out of Boston to start his Midnight Ride! Throw a tea chest into the water, just like the colonists did!

Enjoy stunning views of the Boston skyline on the return trip to Long Wharf where the tour ends. Take advantage of the small group atmosphere of the tour to chat with the boat captain while watching airplanes take off from the airport runway and fly right above your head!

data.cancellation_summary: 7 or more days prior 100%; 3-7 days prior 50%; no refund within 3 days
data.cancellation_notes:
- You will receive a full refund if you cancel at least 7 days before your tour 
- You will receive a 50% refund if you cancel at least 3 days before your tour
- No refunds within 3 days, but we will give you a 50% off coupon to book a new slot
data.booking_notes:
Please arrive at least 10 minutes prior to your tour. The tour can not wait for late arrivals, nor can the guide answer calls once the tour begins. Note that the tour begins next to a Tatte Bakery & Café, so if you need coffee or breakfast, we recommend getting it there so you don't run late.

If you do arrive late, please follow the itinerary on our website to find the group.
data.check_in_details: Recommend arriving 15 minutes early to check in and ensure you find the group. Tours start on time.
data.special_requirements: Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
data.health_and_safety_notes: Part of this tour takes place on a boat over Boston Harbor. The boat is secure and provides all necessary safety equipment, including life jackets, but please use extra caution to ensure your own safety during the tour.
data.disclaimers: The boat portion of the tour is run in partnership with Red Top Boats. Their captains will make cancellation determinations based on weather.
